items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The guards `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):` and `if not remote_field.is_cached(rel_obj):` follow the style of the code around them and read clearly. The added test uses short names like `l`, `r` and `w`, but only in test code, so it is minor.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The fix reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`) and adds one small guard at each of three sibling sites. It adds no new bookkeeping, dead code or debug output, and the scratch script was deleted. Guarding the forward and one-to-one paths goes beyond the reference fix, but the change is consistent and harmless.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The guard only skips the assignment when the relation is already cached, so there is nothing to swallow and no new failure modes. The full prefetch_related and defer suites pass, and all hidden tests pass (P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The assignment is guarded by `self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)` in create_reverse_many_to_one_manager, and the same guard is added in ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset. The reverse relation is still populated when nothing is cached. The new test covers both the one-to-one and reverse-FK variants.
